question:
I need a docker container being run by a google cloud run job to have access to the default credentials stored on the VM the container is spun up on but so far have been unable to do this.

Does anyone have any methods for doing this?

For context this is so I can run DBT and have it connect to BigQuery using the OAuth method.
title: How To Get a Container To Use Google Cloud Run VM Default Credentials?
answer: To get a token, you need to make an http request to a special endpoint, http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token with the header Metadata-Flavor: Google set. Docs for the service identity are here.
